detail: Biomapas Group, a portfolio company of Carbyne Equity Partners, has acquired Pinnaxis IT Solutions and Consulting Private Limited, a pharmacovigilance technology and consulting company. JSA Advocates and Solicitors advised the Biomapas Group on this acquisition. The transaction team was led by Sidharrth Shankar (Partner), and comprised Nandini Seth (Partner) and Aditya Vardhan Dayal (Partner), along with Pranav Rao N (Senior Associate), Bulbul Tiwari (Senior Associate), Associates Aditya Sinha, Aashreya Kodesia, and Rahul Nayyar, Vadi PS (Senior Company Secretary), and Eshika Phadke.
